decisions.reason: As an extension of the core construction range, the articulated dumper carries meaningful engineering and market-launch commitment, and without clear failure signals management would be inclined to continue backing it.

The mine rescue vehicle is more vulnerable because it is farther from the main range and likely niche, but its fit with the firm's underground-specialist identity and the tendency to justify prior investment still favor giving it more time.
A telescopic loader line with several models represents a large and visible commitment in the core business, making withdrawal within the next year unlikely absent strong negative evidence.
The material-lift line is close to the established offer and is supported by a visible large-order success, so both commercial confirmation and prior commitment strongly support keeping it.

Despite being more distant from the traditional range, the compact underground mining loader has shown credible early operating success, which gives management good grounds to persist with the launch.
